criterion_bindings.exemption: Envelope closure is a per-call schema property. The guarantee is proved by TestEnvelopeRejectsUnknownVariantsAndFields and TestEnvelopeRejectsUnknownFieldsAcrossEveryOutcome (internal/agent/envelope_test.go).
Authority semantics are per-call properties. The guarantee is proved by TestEnvelopeGoldenOutcomes (internal/agent/envelope_test.go).

Output bounds are producer-enforced per call. The guarantee is proved by TestEnvelopeHasHardSerializedLimit and TestMutationResultProducerAcceptsCanonicalPayload (internal/agent/envelope_test.go), and TestBudgetFieldsRefuseOrBoundResultsStructurally (internal/agent/runtime_test.go).
Cursor binding is a dispatch property. The guarantee is proved by TestAuthenticatedCursorBindsOperationAndRejectsTampering (internal/agent/runtime_test.go).

Durable-outcome honesty is proved at both levels: TestOutcomeMismatchIsClosedAndCannotDowngrade (internal/agent/envelope_test.go) and the AJ6-partial-publication scenario of the agent-jobs corpus under TestAgentJobsCorpus (internal/agent/agent_jobs_corpus_test.go).
